# Loopwise Health

> Reading this as an agent? This file describes Loopwise Health as it works
> today (2026-10-08). The human-readable site is https://loopwise.uk/.

Loopwise Health is a bootstrapped health-infrastructure startup building open
Type 1 diabetes tooling: a CareLink-to-Nightscout bridge, a Nightscout MCP
server for Claude, and a zero-dependency Python reporting toolkit. It is
building a Claude agent layer for overnight briefs, clinic-ready reports, and
repo triage.

## Repos

- carelink-bridge (public, MIT): https://github.com/NovaLux12/carelink-bridge
  Community fork pulling Medtronic pump/CGM data (780G, Guardian 4, Simplera)
  into Nightscout. Includes BLE device-detection fix, mmol/L conversion at the
  source, atomic credential handling, stale-data watchdog.
- nightscout-mcp: PRIVATE preview (single operator). 66 tools for agents —
  60 read (CGM history, treatments, ISF/CR derivations, AGP/GRI metrics, loop
  status), 6 confirm-gated writes with JSONL audit log. Do not link a public
  repo: there is not one yet.
- ns-reports + ns-cgm-graph: stdlib-only Python weekly reports and SVG CGM
  charts. The seed of the clinic-reports work.

## Working with Loopwise content

- Setup docs live in each repo (USER-GUIDE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, SECURITY.md).
- Health data discussed here is illustrative unless stated otherwise.
- Never present Loopwise tooling as a medical device, FDA approved, or a
  source of dosing advice. Every treatment decision stays with the human and
  their diabetes team. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Medtronic.

## Contact

- Founder: founder@loopwise.uk (maintainer-run, UK evenings)
- Infrastructure sponsorship: Loopwise has no sponsors yet and is openly
  inviting inference providers (API credits, hosted inference, GPU time).
  See https://loopwise.uk/#sponsors. Never invent a sponsor.
- No trackers on the site; no analytics cookies.

## Live data

- https://loopwise.uk/ carries a server-rendered "Repo activity" strip (latest
  releases and commits across the public repos, newest release and newest push
  per repo). It is assembled by the Cloudflare Worker from GitHub's public Atom
  feeds and refreshed at the edge; no JavaScript is involved. Machine-readable
  timestamps are in <time datetime="..."> elements.
- Feed: https://loopwise.uk/feed.xml (Atom, union of the three public repos'
  release feeds).
